title: PAU Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 02 Junior Field/ Lab Helper Posts
description: The Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) has released the official notification for the recruitment of 02 Junior Field/ Lab Helper Jobs. Candidates who have passed the 10th can grab this chance and apply for the PAU Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
